description: Invoke any Reticle tool by name (discover names/params first with reticle_tools). On an unknown tool or bad arguments it returns the available names or the tool's params, so you can correct and retry.

sessionId.description: Target tab for the invoked tool. Forwarded to it — an explicit args.sessionId wins.

tool.description: Tool name to invoke, e.g. reticle_network.

name: reticle_run
